plrops.session.STOPPED: Stopped, Player service not in force
plrops.refusal.NOT_AUTHORISED: You do not hold the permission this needs. The screen you came from names who grants it.
plrops.refusal.NOT_FOUND: That record does not exist, or you may not see it. Check the identifier in the link you followed.
plrops.refusal.DEVICE_ALREADY_ENROLLED: This device is already enrolled, here or at another premises. Open its record instead.
plrops.refusal.CONDITION_OVERLAPS: Part of that period already has a condition in force. Close it or choose a later effective time.
plrops.refusal.DEVICE_NOT_CERTIFIED: This device holds no current certification, so its evidence is not accepted. Certify it against the published criteria first.
plrops.refusal.NO_CAUSE: Choose a cause from the list. It decides what happens to the evidence the device has produced.
plrops.refusal.NO_REPORTED_TIME: Enter the time the loss or compromise is said to have happened. Evidence from that time is quarantined.
plrops.refusal.PENDING_EVIDENCE_UNDECIDE: This device still holds unsynchronised evidence. Choose whether it goes to this premises’ record or is discarded. The decision is recorded under your name.
plrops.refusal.ENTITLEMENT_WOULD_CROSS: A transfer carries no entitlement to the new premises. The new premises’ own entitlement applies from the transfer time.
plrops.refusal.NO_CRITERIA_VERSION: Choose the version of the criteria that was effective when the application was lodged.
plrops.refusal.CRITERIA_VERSION_NOT_PUBL: That version of the criteria is not published. Choose a published version.
plrops.refusal.POLICY_VERSION_NOT_EFFECT: That version of the policy was not effective on the assessment date. Assess against the version in force then.
plrops.refusal.NO_REFUSAL_GROUND: A refusal must name the criterion the application did not meet. Choose it.
plrops.refusal.BELOW_THRESHOLD: The play was shorter than the qualifying threshold. It is recorded but does not become evidence.
plrops.refusal.POLICY_INCOMPLETE: A version needs all four parts: the maximum offline period, the treatment when it is exceeded, the propagation rule and the grace period. Add the missing part.
plr01.title: Player devices
plr01.waitHelp: Plays the device has recorded and not yet sent. It grows while the device is offline.
plr01.heldHelp: Evidence held for a decision. Held evidence is kept out of distribution input.
plr01.sortNote: Sorted by certification end, soonest first.
plr01.emptyTitle: No Player device is enrolled yet.
plr01.emptyText: A device appears here once it is enrolled. Enrol a device before it plays or records evidence.
plr01.filteredText: {n} devices are enrolled. Remove a filter to see more.
plr01.errText: We could not load the device list. Quote the reference below to support.

plr02.heldTextLost: IAM revoked the device identity on {r}. Evidence from {e} onwards stays out of distribution input until {dsp} is decided.
plr02.heldText: This evidence is retained and attributable. It stays out of distribution input until disposition {dsp} releases or excludes it.
plr02.noHistoryText: Each change of condition is added here, with the time it took effect and who recorded it.
plr02.recordEnrolled: The device becomes Active once it holds a current certification and is paired with its premises.
plr02.recordNone: From {s}, the device moves to no other condition.
plr02.fFromNoteLost: When the principal says it went missing. Quarantine counts from here.
plr02.fFromNoteNew: Becomes Active once the device holds a current certification and is paired with its premises.
plr02.formDesc: The condition takes effect at the time you give.
plr02.formDescTransfer: The condition takes effect at the time you give. The device leaves {from} at the transfer time.
plr02.effectiveHelp: Required. A future time takes effect when it arrives.
plr02.optSubmit: Submit them to {from}, where they were played
plr02.groundHelp: Kept with the decision, under your name.
plr02.keep: Keep the device where it is
plr02.cfText: From {e}, {id} is in its new condition. It is recorded under your name and cannot be edited. To change it, record another condition.
plr02.cfTextLost: From {e}, {id} is in its new condition. Evidence the device sent from that time is quarantined and kept. IAM revokes the device identity.
plr02.cfTextTransfer: From {e}, {id} leaves {from} and carries no service entitlement with it. A transfer cannot be undone. To bring the device back, record a new transfer.
plr02.premisesMissing: Choose the premises the device moves to.
plr02.conditionMissing: Choose a condition the device can move to.
plr03.title: Enrol a Player device
plr03.lead: For a device that already holds an identity IAM issued. This form issues no identity and records no certification.
plr03.idHelp: From the label on the device or from IAM, in the form dev-xxxx-xx.
plr03.idInvalid: An identity has the form dev-xxxx-xx: four, then two, lower-case letters or digits.
plr03.supplierInvalid: Choose a supplier in the certification register.
plr03.suppRefused: Its application was refused on {d} against criterion {c}. You can enrol the device, but it stays Newly enrolled and its evidence is not accepted.
plr03.suppExpired: Its certification expired on {d}. You can enrol the device, but it stays Newly enrolled and its evidence is not accepted.
plr03.suppWithdrawn: Its certification was withdrawn on {d}. You can enrol the device, but it stays Newly enrolled and its evidence is not accepted.
plr03.suppOpen: Its application is being assessed. You can enrol the device, but it stays Newly enrolled and its evidence is not accepted.
plr03.premisesInvalid: Choose a premises with a Player service.
plr03.noPremises: No premises has a Player service yet. Devices can be enrolled once one does.
plr03.needPremises: Enrolment needs a premises, and none has a Player service yet.
plr03.needAll: Enter the identity, and choose the supplier and the premises first.
plr03.nextText: The device is Newly enrolled. It becomes Active once it holds a current certification and is paired with its premises. Until then its evidence is not accepted.
plr03.errText: We could not open the enrolment form. Quote the reference below to support.
plr07.title: Batch from {d}
plr07.meta: A batch of {n} events, {a}–{b}, from {p}, received {ts}. Judged under evidence policy version {pv} and service entitlement version {ev}.
plr07.heldText: Retained and attributable. Kept out of distribution input until disposition {dsp} releases or excludes them.
plr07.driftHelp: Device time minus trusted time. Beyond 60 s the event is quarantined.
plr07.emptyTitle: No batch has arrived from {d} since {e}.
plr07.emptyText: The device sends evidence each time it synchronises. A batch appears here as soon as it arrives.

plr10.title: Device certification register
plr10.meta: Under device-assurance policy versions 1 and 2. Updated whenever a decision is made, last on {d}.
plr10.lead: Any device or application supplier can apply, against the same public criteria. A refused application stays in the register with the criterion it did not meet.
plr10.expired: From {d}, the end of version {v}’s {m}-month validity
plr10.sortNote: Sorted by outcome, then by supplier.
plr10.emptyText: An application appears here as soon as it is lodged, including one that is refused.
plr10.filteredTitle: No application in this part of the register.
plr10.filteredText: Choose All to see every application in the register.
plr10.errText: We could not load the register. Try again in a few minutes.
plr10.dlgText: The application is assessed against the published criteria, as every other supplier’s is. A refused application stays in the register with the criterion it did not meet.
plr10.applicantMissing: Enter the supplier name and send it again.
plr10.done: {s}’s application is lodged, against criteria version {v}.
plr10.aText: Record the outcome against criteria {v}. A refusal names the criterion not met.
plr10.outcomeMissing: Choose to certify or to refuse.
plr11.title: Device-assurance policy
plr11.lead: Any device or application supplier can apply for certification against the same criteria. Nobody can reserve certification for a nominated supplier.
plr11.earlier: Version {n} was in effect from {e} to {to}, with a {m}-month validity. It stays readable.
plr11.current: Version {n} is in effect from {e}, with a {m}-month validity.
plr11.applyOff: An application is made against a published version only.
plr11.refTitle: That criteria version is not published
plr11.errText: We could not load the policy. Try again in a few minutes.
plr13.title: Offline-continuity policy
plr13.meta: Draft {n} prepared by {who} on {d}. Until a version is approved, the interim rule is in force.
plr13.metaNone: No version has been drafted yet. Until a version is approved, the interim rule is in force.
plr13.formHelp: A version needs all four parts.
plr13.propagation: How expiry, revocation and takedown reach a device
plr13.graceInfo: 0 means playback stops the moment the limit is reached.
plr13.fromHelp: It may not overlap another version’s effective period.
plr13.part.exceeded: treatment when the period is exceeded
plr13.need.max: Enter the maximum offline period in hours, above 0.
plr13.need.exceeded: Choose what happens when the period is exceeded.
plr13.need.propagation: Choose how a change reaches a device.
plr13.need.grace: Enter the grace period in hours. 0 means playback stops the moment the limit is reached.
plr13.need.from: Choose a date from today onwards.
plr13.savedText: The draft awaits approval. Meanwhile the interim rule stays in force.
plr13.interim1: Each device uses the shortest limit its last synchronised service entitlement carries.
plr13.interim2: A service entitlement with no limit means offline playback does not start.
plr13.approvalNote: Once approved it takes effect on {d}. Until then the interim rule stays in force.
